title.en: SF Bay Chinese community services: immigrant rights, seniors, and legal help
title.zh: 灣區華人社區服務：移民權益、長者與法律協助

excerpt.en: Chinese for Affirmative Action, Self-Help for the Elderly, and API Legal Outreach give Bay Area readers concrete places to start for rights, senior, and legal support.
excerpt.zh: 華人權益促進會、安老自助處與 API Legal Outreach，為灣區讀者提供移民權益、長者與法律支援的實用入口。

body.en: Chinese for Affirmative Action lists immigrant-rights workshops, voter guides, and issue-area resources from its San Francisco Chinatown base. Its current event list includes an online Cantonese and Mandarin immigration webinar.
body.zh: 華人權益促進會從舊金山華埠出發，整理移民權益工作坊、選民指南與議題資源。目前活動列表包含粵語與華語的線上移民資訊講座。

body.en: Self-Help for the Elderly and API Legal Outreach fill different needs: senior services, case support, language access, and legal navigation. Together, they cover practical next steps for many Bay Area families.
body.zh: 安老自助處與 API Legal Outreach 分別補上長者服務、個案支援、語言協助與法律導航。它們合在一起，能提供許多灣區家庭需要的實際下一步。

body.en: Open the source links for eligibility, language options, locations, and appointment details. Services can change by office and program, so the linked pages should be checked before a visit.
body.zh: 請打開來源連結查看資格、語言選項、據點與預約細節。服務可能依辦公室與項目而變動，前往前應先核對原始頁面。

title.en: South Bay civic watch for immigrant families and students
title.zh: 面向移民家庭與學生的南灣市政觀察

excerpt.en: San Jose Spotlight and Asian Law Alliance connect South Bay civic reporting with legal, housing, benefits, and immigrant-resource next steps.
excerpt.zh: San Jose Spotlight 與 Asian Law Alliance 把南灣市政報導，連到法律、住房、福利與移民資源下一步。

body.en: San Jose Spotlight gives South Bay readers reporting on city decisions, development, housing, business issues, and neighborhood debates. That matters for families in San Jose, Santa Clara, Cupertino, Sunnyvale, and Fremont.
body.zh: San Jose Spotlight 為南灣讀者報導市政決策、開發、住房、商業議題與社區討論。這些內容與 San Jose、Santa Clara、Cupertino、Sunnyvale 和 Fremont 家庭相關。

body.en: Asian Law Alliance adds a direct immigrant-resource path for legal navigation, housing, benefits, and community advocacy. It belongs beside civic reporting because readers often need help acting on a policy change.
body.zh: Asian Law Alliance 提供法律導航、住房、福利與社區倡議的移民資源入口。它應與市政報導並列，因為讀者常需要協助把政策變化轉成行動。

body.en: When a South Bay issue affects school routes, rent, permits, or public meetings, start with the reporting link, then confirm services or legal next steps with the resource link.
body.zh: 當南灣議題影響上學路線、租金、許可或公開會議時，可先看報導連結，再用資源連結確認服務或法律下一步。

title.en: East Bay dining openings: milk tea, noodles, cafes, and Chinatown corridors
title.zh: 東灣餐飲新店：奶茶、麵食、咖啡館與華埠走廊

excerpt.en: East Bay Nosh tracks new Oakland, Berkeley, Richmond, Alameda, and nearby restaurant openings, including recent milk tea, dumpling, noodle, cafe, Thai, and Nepali items.
excerpt.zh: East Bay Nosh 追蹤 Oakland、Berkeley、Richmond、Alameda 與周邊新店，近期包括奶茶、餃子、麵食、咖啡館、泰餐與尼泊爾餐飲。

body.en: East Bay Nosh's new-restaurant page is active local coverage for Oakland, Berkeley, Richmond, Alameda, and nearby cities. Recent items include milk tea, Thai, Nepali, cafe, dumpling, noodle, taco, and ramen openings.
body.zh: East Bay Nosh 的新餐廳頁面持續報導 Oakland、Berkeley、Richmond、Alameda 與周邊城市。近期項目包含奶茶、泰餐、尼泊爾餐、咖啡館、餃子、麵食、墨西哥卷與拉麵。

body.en: That mix matters for ChineseSFBay readers because East Bay plans often revolve around weekend meals, Oakland Chinatown errands, Berkeley student visits, and family meetups east of the bridge.
body.zh: 這種組合對 ChineseSFBay 讀者重要，因為東灣行程常圍繞週末聚餐、Oakland 華埠辦事、Berkeley 學生探訪與海灣大橋以東的家庭聚會。

body.en: Use the linked page to check what just opened and where it sits. Restaurant pages can change quickly, so confirm hours and soft-opening status before making the trip.
body.zh: 可用來源頁確認近期開了什麼店、位置在哪裡。餐廳頁面變動很快，出發前請先確認營業時間與試營運狀態。

title.en: SFO, SJC, and official notices for Bay Area families
title.zh: 灣區家庭應查看的 SFO、SJC 與官方通知

excerpt.en: SFO and San Jose Mineta updates help families verify airport construction, programs, route announcements, and traveler advisories before a trip.
excerpt.zh: SFO 與 San Jose Mineta 更新可幫助家庭在出行前核對機場施工、項目、航線公告與旅客提醒。

body.en: Bay Area travel planning is regional. Families may choose SFO for international routes, SJC for South Bay convenience, or Oakland-area routes depending on where relatives live.
body.zh: 灣區出行規劃本來就是區域性的。家庭可能因國際航線選擇 SFO，因南灣便利選擇 SJC，也可能依親友住所選擇 Oakland 周邊路線。

body.en: The SFO press-release page and San Jose Mineta news releases are the official places to confirm construction notices, new airport programs, route announcements, and traveler advisories.
body.zh: SFO 新聞發布頁與 San Jose Mineta 新聞發布頁，是核對施工通知、新機場項目、航線公告與旅客提醒的官方來源。

body.en: Check them before airport pickups, student move-ins, holiday trips, or business travel. Official notices help confirm what is changing before a social post turns into a travel problem.
body.zh: 機場接送、學生搬家、假期出行或商務旅行前都應查看。官方通知能在社群貼文變成出行問題前，先確認真正改變了什麼。

label.zh: San Jose Mineta 新聞發布
